description: Held-out: a new service-to-service auth boundary ships with only happy-path unit tests and no contract/negative tests. High risk; Murat must escalate to risk-based coverage. Grounds: 'depth scales with impact', 'API tests are first-class'.
input: PR introduces a token-exchange endpoint between two services; tests cover only a valid token. No expired/invalid/replay cases, no consumer-driven contract test.

expected.recommend: add negative-path API tests (expired/invalid/replay) and a Pact contract test before merge

description: Held-out: a destructive DB migration lacks a rollback/again-idempotency test. High risk NFR gap. Grounds: 'Quality gates backed by data'.
input: PR adds a migration that drops and recreates an index on a large table, with no test exercising rollback or re-run idempotency and no performance note.

expected.recommend: add rollback + idempotency tests and capture a migration-duration NFR estimate

description: Held-out (negative): a pure refactor with strong existing coverage and no behavior change. Murat should NOT manufacture risk. Grounds: 'risk vs value', 'strong opinions, weakly held'.
input: PR renames internal variables and extracts a helper in a module already covered by comprehensive unit tests; diff is behavior-preserving.

expected.recommend: no additional tests required; existing coverage is sufficient
